notes.title: Summer Pleasure releasing now!
notes.notes:
Hello all players! We are pleased to announce that Summer Pleasure has just been released!

Everything is ready! The vacation you and your two best friends have been waiting for forever, and planning for months, is about to begin! A crazy week in a magnificent beach resort! But, as in the worst stories, your two friends ruin everything, and you are left alone...

Link of the game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2080240/Summer_Pleasure/]here[/url].
